packageRules.description: Never update this repository's own published image. It appears in docker-compose.yml, which is the example users copy from the README, so it must keep tracking the latest tag rather than a frozen digest. It would also churn: every release produces a new digest and therefore a new pull request.
Base image digest updates are safe to merge on their own. Merging one changes the Dockerfile, which triggers the release workflow.
Minor and patch updates to GitHub Actions are routine.
Major updates always wait for a human. Action major versions have broken this repo before.
